description: The SECOND `keyword`-carrying runtime site keeps the canonical identity too (issue #741). A `map` body is a value context, so an escape inside it raises `ol-return-in-comprehension` (`spec/execution-model.md:226-227`, `spec/error-model.md:116`) rather than `ol-return-outside-proc`, even at the top level — and the EXECUTED Heritage spelling `output` reports `params` `{ keyword: "return", form: "map" }`, byte-identical to the Core twin `tests/conformance/core-language/comprehensions/comprehension-return-in-comprehension` (`:out = map n in [1] [ return :n ]`, same `params`, same `stage: "semantic"`). This site is fixtured separately from the outside-proc one because the runtime carries a SEPARATE copy of the rule for it — the defect was present at both copies, and a fixture for only one would leave the other unpinned. `params` is canonical; the `message` still names what the learner typed. The `source_span` is the whole `output :n` escape statement — the runtime's own span for this rule, which is why identity is asserted on `code` + `params` and not on the span (`spec/error-model.md:255-260`). Issue #815: `execute()` now runs Layer 1 and Layer 2 before Phase 2 and refuses a program carrying an `error`-severity finding (`spec/execution-model.md:659-664`), so no event is emitted and the diagnostic delivered here is the CHECK's. The runtime's own copy of the rule still exists, but it runs only under the `runUnchecked` opt-out — NOT in this fixture, which is checked — and when it does run it is collapsed into the check's by the de-duplication rule (`spec/execution-model.md:741-748`), which is why the runtime's copy never appears beside the check's. So nothing here observes that copy, and reading this fixture as evidence for it would be a mistake: measured, a runtime guard can be deleted outright with the whole conformance corpus still green, because the surviving report is the check's either way. What the runtime copy uniquely contributes is that the run STOPS at the fault, which is written in the event stream rather than in the diagnostics and is pinned by `packages/runtime/src/runtime-guards-halt.test.mjs`.
